_schemaBlockers: importRules.machine: recipes.py requires the literal 'i386' (Packaging/recipes.py importRules validator). BF4's shipped main executable bf4.exe is x86_64 PE32+ (verified: MZ/PE header read on mbp23). recipes.py must be extended to accept 'x86_64' before an import-edition BF4 recipe can validate.
GAME_EXECUTABLES in Packaging/recipes.py is {'nfs2015': 'NFS16.exe'} and DENIED_BACKENDS only covers nfs2015; both need a 'bf4' entry.

storeClient.offerID is validated as a 1-20 digit decimal string. The value below is a contentID taken from BF4's own __Installer/installerdata.xml, which is NOT proven to be the EA app offerId. Do not ship it unverified.
There is no schema slot for a second, 32-bit helper executable (BF4WebHelper.exe) that must run alongside the game, nor for a loopback HTTP port. A new key is required.
There is no schema slot for optional third-party prerequisites the EA installer offers (PunkBuster via -Opt:InstallPB).
storeClient.offerID is a single 1-20 digit decimal string. BF4's launch URL needs a comma-joined list of 20 ids (see _offerID_notes). recipes.py must accept a list.

_requiredRuntimeCapabilities_notes: dxmtDXGI is asserted because bf4.exe imports dxgi.dll and d3d11.dll directly (verified from its import table). trapFlagEmulation is TODO: unknown whether BF4 uses the single-step/trap-flag pattern NFS16 needs. x87Sidecar is TODO: bf4.exe is x86_64 so the x87 Rosetta path is unlikely to matter for it, but bf4_x86.exe, ActivationUI.exe (i386) and BF4WebHelper.exe (i386) are 32-bit and may need it.
_editions_notes: import only for the first milestone. A 'bundled' edition would package ~32 GiB of EA game bytes into an .app; whether that is acceptable is a licensing decision for the owner, and NFS2015's bundled edition precedent exists (nfs2015.json has both).
shaderCache: TODO: recipes.py requires inputs.mtld3dSource when shaderCache is true. BF4 is a D3D11 title served by DXMT, not mtld3d, so this flag is probably false. Unverified.

storeClient._offerID_notes: CORROBORATED, BUT THE SCHEMA CANNOT EXPRESS IT. recipes.py validates offerID as a 1-20 DIGIT decimal string, i.e. one id. BF4 needs a comma-joined list of 20. The Lutris issue tracker (https://github.com/lutris/lutris/issues/4996) records the working URL as origin2://game/launch/?offerIds=1007968,1011575,1011576,1011577,1010268,1010269,1010270,1010271,1010958,1010959,1010960,1010961,1007077,1016751,1016757,1016754,1015365,1015364,1015363,1015362 - character-for-character the same 20 ids, in the same order, as the <contentIDs> block in the owner's own __Installer/installerdata.xml (verified on mbp23). Two independent sources agreeing on 20 nine-digit numbers in one order is not coincidence: for BF4 the manifest contentIDs ARE the offerIds. ACTION: extend recipes.py to accept a list of ids (or a comma-joined string with a longer bound), then confirm against the owner's own ProgramData/Origin/Logs/*_OnlineActivation_Log.html (where nfs2015's 1024486 came from, per docs/NFS2015-RECIPE.md:43-44) and TRIM any DLC ids the owner does not own.

_prerequisites.note: From __Installer/installerdata.xml (verified). These are what EA's Touchup installs; under Wine some are supplied by Wine itself.
_prerequisites.vc2012Update3: __Installer/vc/vc2012Update3/redist/vcredist_x64.exe (7185000 bytes) and vcredist_x86.exe (6552288 bytes). bf4.exe imports MSVCR110.dll and MSVCP110.dll, so the VC++ 2012 runtime is a hard requirement. Manifest declares installedSize 39636173.
_prerequisites.directx: __Installer/directx/redist/DXSETUP.exe (517976 bytes) + 159 .cab files + DSETUP.dll + dsetup32.dll. Manifest declares installedSize 144378352. Needed for the D3DX/XAudio/XACT side; d3dcompiler_46.dll ships in the game folder (x86_64, imports d3d10.dll and D3DCOMPILER_46.dll).
_prerequisites.gdf: __Installer/GDFBinary_en_US.dll and GDFBinary_en_US_64.dll (339224 bytes each) - Windows Games Explorer metadata; cosmetic, Wine has no Games Explorer.
_prerequisites.touchup: __Installer/touchup.exe, invoked by the manifest as: install -locale {locale} -installPath "{installLocation}" -autologging ; update variant adds -update ; repair variant adds -repair. featureFlags set forceTouchupInstallerAfterUpdate="1" and treatUpdatesAsMandatory="1".
